card.name: Cautionary phrasing in warnings
card.fires_on: The word after a warning opener such as 'Consideration should be' (mainly 'given'), or other words in a label warning that introduce an action to take, such as 'Suspect bleeding in any' or 'should lead'.

modes.label: Consideration should be given
modes.description: The word 'given' ending the stock phrase that precedes advice to change or avoid a treatment.
modes.example: Consideration should be<< given>> to changing the therapeutic regimen, including possibly

modes.label: Other warning leads
modes.description: Words in warning sentences that lead into an instruction to look for or act on a problem.
modes.example: Suspect bleeding in<< any>> patient who is hypotensive and has
